tei:div.tei:p: 1) rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/

dbus bza' mkha' 'gro kun bzang chos nyid bde skyong dbang mo ni spyi lo dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i smad tsam(1880-1929)la dbus 'gyur lha ldan grong khyer chen po'i rgya sde ra ga shar ba'i yul grong gi mi dpon chen po byams pa mgon po zhes pa'i lha lcam du sku 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu'i skabs gzhan las lhag pa'i khyad rtags ngo mtshar ba dpog dka' ba du ma dang ldan/ yab kyis srid khri 'dzin pa'i dmigs 'dun gyi ched du skyed bsring byas kyang don gnyer mi gnang zhing*/ nges med du sus kyang don go dka' ba'i snyan ngag lta bu'i tshigs bcad mang po byung rgyal du smra zhing gyer ba dang*/ rang gis rnyed pa yin zer te yul gling na med pa'i dngos rdzas mtshar po mang po rtag tu bsnams shing 'ong*/ de tsam nas kun gyis smon pa'i yul du byed pa skyid shod grong dpon gyi rgyal sras dang chung gnyen byas kyang rang bzhin phal ba'i khyim thab mi byed ces thugs 'thad ye mi gnang bar mdzad/ dgung lo bcu skor tsam nas mdo khams na dam chos rdzogs pa chen po bya ba yod pas nga rang gi tshe 'dir de la bya ba/ 2)byed dgos sogs yang yang gsung/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la mdo khams gser rta'i gter sgar gyi rgyal sras rin po che sprul dri med tshang gi sgar ba dbus mjal ba'i rjes su gsang stabs kyis 'brang ste lo phyi mar mdo khams su 'byor/ de nas re zhig yul mgo log gi 'brog khyim po zhig tu g.yog las lta bu'i lto gos 'phyid pa'i tshul mdzad dgos byung la/ rim gyis khyim tshang des mi bdag legs po byas nas gces par bskyangs kyang khyim thab sogs mi byed par dam chos don gnyer gyis sdod yul nges med byas/ gang du phyin yang ngo mtshar ba'i rnam dpyod dag blo jus ldan zhing*/ rang bzhin gyi mi las 'phags pa'i khyad chos ji ltar sbas kyang lhag ger gsal bas kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog pa yod kyang*/

skye 'bras mtshar ba sogs kyis rkyen byas tshul min gyis bslangs pa'i kha zer yang 'ga' zhig 'ong zhing phrin las la bar chad cung zad re byung na'ang rim gyis khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa dang*/ rigs sras dri med 'od zer/ mgar ba gter chen bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pa/ dpal yul sgo sprul rin po che sogs rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen dang grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma las thun min zab chos kyi gdams pa thob pas sa lam gyi yon tan zab mo mngon du byas shing*/ skabs du mar phan tshun smin grol gyi sa la bkod pa sogs thugs bskyed 3)dang smon lam dus su babs te gsang gsum gyi bgyi ba bla na ma mchis pas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che gegs bral lhun grub tu byung la/ zab mo gter gyi 'gro don la gcig tu dbang zhing*/ gtan pa med pa 'chad rtsom chos sbyin gyi sgo 'phar yangs por grol nas legs mdzad phrin las kyi snang ba dkar pos mgo log dang gser rta sogs kyi gtso'i mdo khams sa chen po'i khor yug gcig tu khyab par mdzad/ mthar dgung grangs zhe dgu tsam na khams ri bo cher gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so// gsung chos mang du bzhugs na'ang*/ phyis dus zing gi dbang du shor bas nyung ngu las med par gyur zhing dpe rgyun yang shin tu dkon/ 'brel yod mi sna dang sde khag dag gis lo mang por rtsad gcod byas pa brgyud da lta pod drug tsam bzhugs pa gtso bo theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi zin bris sogs thun min gzhung 'grel gyi skor dang*/ zab gsang gnyis med kyi nyams len thabs las man ngag zab mo'i bstan bcos/ thun min nye brgyud zab mo gter gyi chos skor la gtso bo yi dam gyi sgrub thabs bskyed rdzogs las mtha' dang bcas pa du ma dang*/ nad rims zhe byed/ bar chad sel byed/ phyugs god btsa' thal 'gos bcos/

khor yug srung thabs dang sa bcud gso thabs sogs yod la/ 4)gzhan rang rnam ngo mtshar ba pod chen gcig dang*/ nyams mgur snang glu thol rtsom sogs mang du bzhugs so// de dag rjod byed rtsom nyams kyi cha nas rnam thar lta bu kha gsal zhing 'gros bde ba/ bod spyi ba'i brda sprod rnam bzhag ma dkrugs sor bzhag gi steng yul khams dag bstun pa'i 'bangs mi rang bzhin pa'i brjod stangs shugs che bas bab chags shing snying nye ba'i 'bol rtsom gyi nyams thon la/ rjod stangs kyi cha kho nas kyang rang bzos su ma song ba'i bden pa'i nyams dang yid ches su 'os pa'i tshor ba ster bar byed/ gsung mgur dang snang glu lta bur spyir bod kyi sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi legs cha ldan pa la bye brag bud med rigs kyi lhan skyes kyi thun min tshor ba grung po la brten nas yul bkod dang 'tsho ba brtse dung sogs nyams su len stangs khyad par ba zhig gi ngos nas dpyis phyin par brjod yod pas/ su dang yang mi 'dra ba'i thun min sger khyad lhang du thon cing*/ bod kyi rtsom rig skyed tshal du de sngon mthong dkon pa'i me tog sar ba'i tsham bu du ma star phreng du bkod par snang*/ de bzhin mchog dang rang bzhin gyi bu slob kyang grangs las 'das pa bskyangs pa rnam thar du gsal bas 'dir skyang 'god kyi ngal ba ma byas/ 5)mdor na thun min gsang ba'i rnam thar smra bar rngo mi thogs mod/ thun mong skye bo'i snang ngo ltar na'ang khong gis shes rab brtson 'grus mdzes sdug dang bcas pa rnam gsum dbyer med kyi rnam thar rmad du byung ba zhig mi yul 'dir bskrun yod cing*/ lo rgyus su bod kyi bud med dag la rig pa'i slob gso nyer len gyi go skabs phra ba'i gnas tshul 'og mkhas btsun bzang po'i bang rim mthon par gsang stabs kyis phyin te kha ba can gyi ma cig gnyis pa lta bur gyur ba shin tu ngo mtshar che ba zhig go// /
zhes pa'ang mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang nas spyi lo 2008 lo'i zla 6 par bgyis pa'o//
